items.title: Pen-up points in digitizer units, the PointUtils ranges and the stroke time unit
items.reason: the SDK does not state the unit of a pen-up event's points, measured, nor of Stroke.recognPoints' timestamps [inference: milliseconds]

evidence.source: sn-plugin-lib 0.2.3 PointUtils; measured on a Manta

items.upgradePath: an SDK release that documents the unit or sends screen pixels

probe.unprobed: needs a pen stroke; the effect test is the Smart Pen device round

items.title: penType 4 is a lasso path and 16 the ink pen
items.reason: the SDK lists pens 1, 10, 11 and 15 only; 4 and 16 were measured
items.upgradePath: an SDK release that lists every penType

probe.unprobed: needs a pen stroke and a lasso; the effect test is the Smart Pen device round

items.title: Pen replay: a recorded stroke inserted through the official element calls and handed to the plugin's own pen listeners
items.reason: level 1 is the highest; the routes below it were rejected: sendevent to the pen node is refused and input stylus motionevent draws no lasso (measured, #148); a stroke inserted with insertPageElements raises no event_pen_up, so no conversion starts (observed device behaviour, #298); emitting the SDK's own plugin event inside the plugin would reach the listeners but rests on an undocumented SDK internal (level 3)

evidence.source: sn-plugin-lib 0.2.3 PluginManager.registerEventListener and createElement; measured on a Manta (#148, #298)

items.upgradePath: none: the route is already level 1; it tests our plugin logic, not the host's pen delivery, which the one real-pen smoke per release covers

probe.unprobed: needs one real-pen recording; the effect test is Smart Pen's replay in the device round (#298)
